name: Michael Garrett
summary: In the Undercity, Michael Garrett awaits a crate bound for the Sepulcher. Gordon Wendham packs field supplies in the Trade Quarter, and you bring them to Garrett for the Forsaken bat network to carry toward Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: Supplying the Outposts
sections.body: The Forsaken send supplies from the Undercity to outposts such as the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Gordon Wendham packs field supplies in a crate in the Trade Quarter. Moving freight along the ground through blighted forests is slow and leaves it open to ambush by Scourge remnants or wild beasts.

sections.title: Wings of the Forsaken
sections.body: The Forsaken use captive vampire bats, bred and kept by skilled handlers, to avoid dangerous roads. Michael Garrett tends the bats from his roost in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. When you bring him the cargo, it can be strapped to a bat and flown over the hills toward Silverpine, linking the capital with its outposts.

faq.answer: Michael Garrett handles bats in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. He arranges travel and air deliveries between the Forsaken capital and allied flight masters throughout Lordaeron.
Gordon Wendham's crate holds field supplies for Forsaken forces stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why use bats instead of carts or horses?
faq.answer: The roads are hazardous, and trained giant bats fly much faster while bypassing ground ambushes.

faq.q: Where does the delivery go after Michael Garrett?
faq.answer: After Michael Garrett receives Gordon's Crate, the cargo is prepared for flight to the bat master stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Where can Michael Garrett be found in Undercity?
faq.answer: Michael Garrett is in the southwestern part of the Trade Quarter, where bats arriving from the Sepulcher land.

faq.q: Do you need to have visited the Sepulcher before doing this?
faq.answer: To ride a bat alongside the delivery, you must have spoken with the flight handler at the Sepulcher to open the route. Otherwise, you travel there on foot.

angles.text: The aerial supply line run by handlers such as Michael Garrett helps maintain Sylvanas's presence beyond Tirisfal Glades.
For travelers arriving from Kalimdor, the Forsaken bat network is the primary way to travel quickly across the northern Eastern Kingdoms.
